_meta.description: Schema for review findings JSON passed to review-finalize.js. Referenced by /review-issue Step 3.

repairs.description: Pre-finalize repairs (#3544): one per criterion /review-issue fixed in the body before finalize, unprompted. criterion is the criterion id (review-repairs.json); before is the replaced text, empty when the section was absent; after is the text written. Rendered as ✅ repaired in the review comment so each can be reverted.

acVerdicts.description: One verdict per acceptance criterion in the issue body, in body order; index is 1-based and text is the criterion as written. For bug/enhancement/story/epic/generic reviews finalize rejects the findings when this does not cover every criterion extractAcceptanceCriteria() returns (#3541). An issue with no acceptance-criteria section passes [].

notes: findings.userEvaluated is empty [] in solo review mode
type must match the issue type from preamble context
type drives the review comment header verb in review-finalize.js formatReviewComment(); prd/proposal/test-plan are tracker-shaped (#2594)
